nodes.label: Action-first architecture rule
nodes.rationale: Business logic must live in core/actions/ to decouple UI from data access; prevents supabase.from() calls inside components and centralizes mutation logic.

nodes.label: Hook state management rule
nodes.rationale: Fetch + state logic goes in hooks (useProperties, useAuth) to keep components pure renderers; prevents useEffect/fetch duplication across views.

nodes.label: Styles always in componentStyles.ts rule
nodes.rationale: Inline styles are banned except for truly dynamic values; each component uses a getXxxStyles(t, mode) function for consistent theming and mode switching.

nodes.label: Lucide icons only rule
nodes.rationale: Emojis in code are forbidden to maintain visual consistency across the app; WhatsApp message formatter is the only exception.

nodes.label: CRM three-tab structure
nodes.rationale: Vista Hoy uses activity-based operational queue (pending/overdue/abandoned) rather than opportunity-stage grouping. Vista Leads and Vista Propietarios group by pipeline stage. This dual view was chosen because activities drive daily work while stages track pipeline progress.

nodes.label: CRM urgency scoring system
nodes.rationale: getScore() combines stage score, overdue activities, pending today, upcoming visits, inactivity penalty, follow-up count, positive results, pending priority, and overdue next_action_date. getCalor() maps score to heat colors (red/orange/gray). Design prioritizes recency of activity over stage alone.

nodes.label: Stage-to-message mapping
nodes.rationale: getTipoMensaje() derives WhatsApp message template from opportunity stage and pipeline_type. Lead stages map to progressive messaging (primer_contacto → seguimiento → confirmar_visita). Propietario pipeline uses separate templates (propietario_contacto → propietario_seguimiento).

links.rationale: AI toggle on ChatPanel enables Gemini fallback for unrecognized chat commands via useChat hook which imports from parseIntent

Both useOpportunities and useTimeline manipulate the same Supabase 'activities' table with overlapping schemas (opportunity_id, type, status, scheduled_at). useTimeline is called with cargarActivities as onActivityCreated callback, creating a data sync dependency.
CRMApp delegates all data logic to useOpportunities and useTimeline hooks, keeping the component as a pure renderer.

CRMApp has extensive inline styles and some inline array definitions (TIPOS_ACTIVIDAD, RESULTADOS), which contradicts the componentStyles.ts and constants.ts rules. This is the documented exception for dynamic values, but usage exceeds that exception.
PropertiesView delegates property mutations to core/actions/properties (duplicateProperty, getProperty, filterAndSortProperties) instead of calling supabase directly, following the action-first rule.
PropertiesView uses useAuth and useProperties hooks for all state, never calling useEffect/fetch directly.
